purpose: Supplemental Depot native runner execution following the product-scope correction; not final acceptance.

native.workflowDefinition:
name: depot-native-runner-followup-hosts

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cohort_id:
        description: Frozen complete-graph replay identifier
        required: true
        type: string
      manifest_sha256:
        description: SHA-256 of the shared frozen complete manifest
        required: true
        type: string
      requested_at:
        description: Shared request instant in ISO 8601 UTC
        required: true
        type: string
      source_head:
        description: Immutable source revision
        required: true
        type: string
      hosts:
        description: Required native hosts for this case
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: both
        options:
        - both
        - macos

env:
  GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: depot-complete-native-${{ inputs.source_head }}-${{ inputs.hosts }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  native:
    name: Native package gates (${{ matrix.runner }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.hosts == 'macos' && '["depot-macos-15"]' || '["depot-windows-2025-4", "depot-macos-15"]') }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: source
    env:
      MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
      MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS: ${{ github.workspace }}
      # Both reviewed source revisions declare these exact tool versions.
      MISE_NODE_VERSION: '26.11.1'
      MISE_RUST_VERSION: nightly-2026-10-13
      MISE_CMAKE_VERSION: '4.4.4'
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
      CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
      SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ inputs.source_head }}
    steps:
    - name: Record actual runner hardware and provider identity
      working-directory: .
      run: node --input-type=module -e 'const os = await import("node:os"); console.log(JSON.stringify({event:"depot-runner-hardware",platform:process.platform,architecture:process.arch,cpus:os.cpus().length,memoryBytes:os.totalmem(),runnerName:process.env.RUNNER_NAME,runnerOs:process.env.RUNNER_OS,runnerArchitecture:process.env.RUNNER_ARCH,githubSha:process.env.GITHUB_SHA}));'
    - name: Checkout trial harness
      uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
      with:
        path: harness
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Checkout immutable source
      uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
      with:
        path: source
        ref: ${{ inputs.source_head }}
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Set up mise
      uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c
      with:
        # Bootstrap version already verified in this trial.
        version: 2026.10.9
        working_directory: harness
        install: false
        cache: false
        env: false
        export_path: false
    - name: Install the source-declared Node and Cargo tool prerequisites
      working-directory: harness
      run: mise install --yes node@26.11.1 rust@nightly-2026-10-13 cargo-binstall@1.25.3
    - name: Install source-declared native tools after Rust
      id: tools
      working-directory: harness
      run: mise install --yes cargo:cargo-nextest@0.9.148 cmake@4.4.4
    - name: Install and verify Clippy for the exact source toolchain
      working-directory: harness
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:native:components
    - name: Expose the source-declared Windows linker
      if: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' }}
      run: echo 'C:\Program Files\LLVM\bin' >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
    - name: Verify immutable source and record tools
      id: identity
      working-directory: harness
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:native:identity
    - name: Record frozen source provenance before consumers
      id: provenance-before
      working-directory: harness
      env:
        MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
        MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS: ${{ github.workspace }}
        MISE_NODE_VERSION: '26.11.1'
        SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/source
        SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ inputs.source_head }}
        PROVENANCE_PHASE: before
        PROVENANCE_CASE: native
        PROVENANCE_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/depot-provenance
        COHORT_ID: ${{ inputs.cohort_id }}
        COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.manifest_sha256 }}
        COHORT_REQUESTED_AT: ${{ inputs.requested_at }}
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:coherent:provenance
    - name: Restore exact-source native artifacts
      uses: actions/cache@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.cargo/registry
          ~/.cargo/git
          source/package/music-player/desktop-app/target
        key: depot-native-runner-followup-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ inputs.source_head }}
    - name: Build release artifact through the package task
      id: build
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.identity.outcome == 'success' && steps.provenance-before.outcome == 'success' }}
      run: mise run //package/music-player/desktop-app:build
    - name: Run all-target Clippy through the package task
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.identity.outcome == 'success' && steps.provenance-before.outcome == 'success' }}
      run: mise run //package/music-player/desktop-app:lint:clippy
    - name: Run every nextest case with the source task body
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.identity.outcome == 'success' && steps.provenance-before.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: harness
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:native:nextest
    - name: Exercise the built release command
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build.outcome == 'success' && steps.provenance-before.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: harness
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:native:smoke
    - name: Verify source remained immutable
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.identity.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: harness
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:native:identity
    - name: Record frozen source provenance after consumers
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.provenance-before.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: harness
      env:
        MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
        MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS: ${{ github.workspace }}
        MISE_NODE_VERSION: '26.11.1'
        SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/source
        SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ inputs.source_head }}
        PROVENANCE_PHASE: after
        PROVENANCE_CASE: native
        PROVENANCE_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/depot-provenance
        COHORT_ID: ${{ inputs.cohort_id }}
        COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.manifest_sha256 }}
        COHORT_REQUESTED_AT: ${{ inputs.requested_at }}
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:coherent:provenance
    - name: Preserve frozen source provenance
      if: ${{ always() }}
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: depot-native-provenance-${{ inputs.source_head }}-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/depot-provenance
        if-no-files-found: error

windows.workflowDefinition:
name: depot-native-runner-followup-windows

# Builds, tests and smoke-runs the music player desktop app (package/music-player/desktop-app) on real
# Windows runners, in three flavors that need three different toolchains. Decision and rationale:
# doc/decision/music-player-windows-linkers.md.
#
# - x86_64-pc-windows-msvc on x64 and aarch64-pc-windows-msvc on arm64: Visual Studio's own link.exe
#   links the program (the .cargo/config.toml of the package sets no linker for either target).
# - x86_64-pc-windows-gnu on x64: the Rust GNU host toolchain with an MSYS2 MinGW-w64 gcc, so GNU ld
#   links the program. No Visual Studio tool is used to build that job's program.
#
# Every job runs cargo nextest for its target, builds the real binary, prints the linker rustc ran,
# inspects the PE header (import table and Subsystem field), runs the program with --version from bash and from
# PowerShell, with and without output redirection, and starts the program.
#
# The program is a GUI-subsystem executable (Subsystem 2): double-clicking it opens no console window. It attaches to
# the console of its parent process when it has one, so --version still prints in a terminal. Decision and sources:
# doc/decision/music-player-windows-gui-subsystem.md.
#
# Caches (one entry per job): the cargo registry index and downloaded crates, the git db, and the package
# target directory. The key holds the runner OS and architecture, the target, the Rust toolchain version
# and the hash of both Cargo.lock files; restore-keys fall back to the same target and toolchain without
# the lockfile hash, so a lockfile change rebuilds only the changed crates. Entries are lean: no
# incremental directories, no debug info, and this package's own artifacts are pruned before the save.
# Caches are saved only on main and on workflow_dispatch, never on pull requests (a pull
# request run still restores the entries main saved).

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cohort_id:
        description: Frozen complete-graph replay identifier
        required: true
        type: string
      manifest_sha256:
        description: SHA-256 of the shared frozen complete manifest
        required: true
        type: string
      requested_at:
        description: Shared request instant in ISO 8601 UTC
        required: true
        type: string
  pull_request:
    paths:
    - 'package/music-player/desktop-app/**'
    - 'package/music-player/truepeak-core/**'
    - '.github/workflows/music-player-windows.yml'
  push:
    branches:
    - 'main'
    paths:
    - 'package/music-player/desktop-app/**'
    - 'package/music-player/truepeak-core/**'
    - '.github/workflows/music-player-windows.yml'

permissions: {}

env:
  GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  # The root mise config lists heavy dev tools with auto_install on. This workflow does not use mise
  # (rustup comes with every runner image), but the setting keeps any accidental mise call from building them.
  # Same pattern as npm-release.yml and music-player-release.yml.
  MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
  # The Slint UI uses experimental builtins (FlexboxLayout); the package mise.toml sets this for its tasks.
  # SLINT_EMIT_DEBUG_INFO makes the ElementHandle UI tests find their elements (the mise test task sets it too).
  SLINT_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES: '1'
  SLINT_EMIT_DEBUG_INFO: '1'
  # Lean cache entries and fast cold builds: no incremental directories, no debug info in dependencies.
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: 'always'
  # Release version of cargo-nextest, and the SHA-256 of its Windows archive per architecture. The archive
  # URL is https://github.com/nextest-rs/nextest/releases/download/cargo-nextest-<version>/... .
  NEXTEST_VERSION: '0.9.148'

concurrency:
  group: music-player-windows-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  windows:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    if: ${{ !github.event.repository.fork }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
        - name: msvc-x64
          runner: depot-windows-2025-4
          target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          flavor: msvc
          nextest-target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          nextest-sha256: bef17504bed9d4994cf860c122e84a90d613b92e6d89584fa9e28bd53ad42e15
        - name: msvc-arm64
          runner: windows-11-arm
          target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
          flavor: msvc
          nextest-target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
          nextest-sha256: e8b2681657565435b95caf029512cb9e5782db13ad908ca02b1828b92b579dda
        # UCRT64 is the MSYS2 environment its documentation recommends (MINGW64 is deprecated since 2026-03-15). A
        # MINGW64 job was run alongside it for four runs and passed the same tests with an msvcrt.dll-only import table;
        # the measured imports of both are in doc/decision/music-player-windows-linkers.md.
        - name: gnu-x64-ucrt64
          runner: depot-windows-2025-4
          target: x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
          flavor: gnu
          msystem: UCRT64
          msys-dir: ucrt64
          nextest-target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          nextest-sha256: bef17504bed9d4994cf860c122e84a90d613b92e6d89584fa9e28bd53ad42e15
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
      JOB_NAME: ${{ matrix.name }}
    steps:
    - name: Record actual runner hardware and provider identity
      working-directory: .
      run: node --input-type=module -e 'const os = await import("node:os"); console.log(JSON.stringify({event:"depot-runner-hardware",platform:process.platform,architecture:process.arch,cpus:os.cpus().length,memoryBytes:os.totalmem(),runnerName:process.env.RUNNER_NAME,runnerOs:process.env.RUNNER_OS,runnerArchitecture:process.env.RUNNER_ARCH,githubSha:process.env.GITHUB_SHA}));'
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
      with:
        ref: 3434eaa455d569c18b52cf15100f77f9db251d21
        fetch-depth: 1
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Checkout frozen trial provenance harness
      uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
      with:
        path: trial-provenance-harness
        ref: ${{ github.sha }}
        fetch-depth: 1
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Set up the proven provenance task runner
      uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c
      with:
        version: 2026.10.9
        working_directory: trial-provenance-harness
        install: false
        cache: false
        env: false
        export_path: false
    - name: Install the source-declared provenance runtime
      working-directory: trial-provenance-harness
      env:
        MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
        MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS: ${{ github.workspace }}
      run: mise install --yes node@26.11.1
    - name: Record frozen source provenance before consumers
      id: provenance-before
      working-directory: trial-provenance-harness
      env:
        MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
        MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS: ${{ github.workspace }}
        MISE_NODE_VERSION: '26.11.1'
        SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
        SOURCE_HEAD: 3434eaa455d569c18b52cf15100f77f9db251d21
        PROVENANCE_PHASE: before
        PROVENANCE_CASE: windows
        PROVENANCE_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/depot-provenance
        COHORT_ID: ${{ inputs.cohort_id }}
        COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.manifest_sha256 }}
        COHORT_REQUESTED_AT: ${{ inputs.requested_at }}
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:coherent:provenance

    # The repository pins its Rust toolchain in mise.lock (a dated nightly shared by every package); read it
    # from there so this workflow never drifts from what developers build with. The GNU job installs the
    # GNU HOST toolchain: with the default MSVC host, build scripts and proc macros would still be linked
    # by Visual Studio's link.exe, and the job would not prove a build free of Microsoft's toolchain.
    - name: Install the Rust toolchain pinned in mise.lock
      id: toolchain
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        version=$(awk -F'"' '/^\[\[tools\.rust\]\]$/ { in_rust = 1; next } in_rust && /^version = / { print $2; exit }' mise.lock)
        case "$version" in
          nightly-????-??-?? | [0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*) ;;
          *) echo "::error::Unexpected Rust version in mise.lock: '$version'"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        if [ "$FLAVOR" = 'gnu' ]; then
          toolchain="${version}-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu"
        else
          toolchain="$version"
        fi
        rustup toolchain install "$toolchain" --profile minimal --no-self-update
        echo "RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=$toolchain" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        rustc "+$toolchain" -vV

    # Package download cache of the preinstalled MSYS2 (C:\msys64): the .pkg.tar.zst files pacman downloads. The key
    # rotates once a month (MSYS2 publishes new package versions all the time and a cache entry is never updated), and the
    # previous month's entry seeds the new one through restore-keys, so at most one small entry per month exists.
    - name: Name the month for the MSYS2 cache key
      id: month
      if: ${{ matrix.flavor == 'gnu' }}
      run: echo "value=$(date -u +%Y-%m)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    - name: Restore the MSYS2 package cache
      id: msys2-cache
      if: ${{ matrix.flavor == 'gnu' }}
      uses: actions/cache/restore@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae
      with:
        path: C:\msys64\var\cache\pacman\pkg
        key: msys2-pkg-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.msystem }}-${{ steps.month.outputs.value }}
        restore-keys: |
          msys2-pkg-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.msystem }}-

    # The runner image carries MSYS2 in C:\msys64 (not on PATH). It is used directly, without the
    # msys2/setup-msys2 action, which this repository's allowed-actions list does not permit. The package
    # database in the image is stale, so it is refreshed first (`-Sy`); only mingw-w64 packages, which are
    # self-contained under /ucrt64 or /mingw64, are installed, so a partial MSYS2 upgrade is not a concern.
    # gcc brings binutils (GNU ld, as, dlltool, windres) and the MinGW-w64 runtime. cmake and ninja come from
    # the runner image: opusic-sys builds libopus with cmake and picks the Ninja generator when ninja runs.
    - name: Install MinGW-w64 with the preinstalled MSYS2
      if: ${{ matrix.flavor == 'gnu' }}
      env:
        MSYSTEM: ${{ matrix.msystem }}
        MSYS2_PATH_TYPE: strict
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        /c/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe -lc 'pacman --sync --refresh --noconfirm --needed "${MINGW_PACKAGE_PREFIX}-gcc"'
        # Drop cached files of package versions that are no longer installed, so the saved entry stays small.
        /c/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe -lc 'pacman --sync --clean --noconfirm'
        du -sh /c/msys64/var/cache/pacman/pkg

    - name: Put the MinGW-w64 tools first on PATH and print them
      if: ${{ matrix.flavor == 'gnu' }}
      env:
        MSYS_DIR: ${{ matrix.msys-dir }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # Strawberry Perl and older MinGW copies on the runner also ship a gcc; the MSYS2 one must win.
        echo "C:\\msys64\\${MSYS_DIR}\\bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        export PATH="/c/msys64/${MSYS_DIR}/bin:$PATH"
        for tool in gcc ld dlltool windres ar cmake ninja; do
          printf '%s: ' "$tool"; command -v "$tool"
        done
        gcc --version | head -n 1
        ld --version | head -n 1
        gcc -dumpmachine
        # The compiler's default C runtime, from the MinGW-w64 specs: msvcrt for MINGW64, ucrt for UCRT64.
        echo '#include <stdio.h>' | gcc -E -dM -x c - | grep -E '_UCRT|__MSVCRT__' || true

    - name: Install cargo-nextest
      env:
        NEXTEST_TARGET: ${{ matrix.nextest-target }}
        NEXTEST_SHA256: ${{ matrix.nextest-sha256 }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        archive="cargo-nextest-${NEXTEST_VERSION}-${NEXTEST_TARGET}.tar.gz"
        dest="${RUNNER_TEMP}/nextest"
        mkdir -p "$dest"
        curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --location --silent --show-error --fail \
          --output "${dest}/${archive}" \
          "https://github.com/nextest-rs/nextest/releases/download/cargo-nextest-${NEXTEST_VERSION}/${archive}"
        echo "${NEXTEST_SHA256}  ${dest}/${archive}" | sha256sum --check
        # A path with a drive letter would be read by tar as host:path, so extract from inside the directory.
        (cd "$dest" && tar --extract --gzip --file "$archive")
        echo "$(cygpath --windows "$dest")" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

    # Decide once whether this run may write caches: main and manual dispatch.
    - name: Decide whether this run saves caches
      id: policy
      env:
        EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
        REF: ${{ github.ref }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        save=false
        if [ "$EVENT" != 'pull_request' ]; then
          case "$REF" in
            refs/heads/main) save=true ;;
          esac
          if [ "$EVENT" = 'workflow_dispatch' ]; then save=true; fi
        fi
        echo "save=$save" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        echo "Cache saves allowed: $save (event $EVENT, ref $REF)"

    - name: Restore the cargo and target cache
      id: cargo-cache
      uses: actions/cache/restore@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.cargo/registry/index
          ~/.cargo/registry/cache
          ~/.cargo/git/db
          package/music-player/desktop-app/target
        key: mp-win-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.name }}-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ steps.toolchain.outputs.version }}-${{ hashFiles('package/music-player/desktop-app/Cargo.lock', 'package/music-player/truepeak-core/Cargo.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          mp-win-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.name }}-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ steps.toolchain.outputs.version }}-

    - name: Report the cache restore
      env:
        EXACT: ${{ steps.cargo-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
        MATCHED: ${{ steps.cargo-cache.outputs.cache-matched-key }}
        MSYS2_EXACT: ${{ steps.msys2-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        if [ "$EXACT" = 'true' ]; then result='exact hit'
        elif [ -n "$MATCHED" ]; then result="restored from restore-key $MATCHED"
        else result='miss'; fi
        echo "cargo and target cache: $result"
        if [ "$FLAVOR" = 'gnu' ]; then echo "msys2 package cache exact hit: ${MSYS2_EXACT:-false}"; fi
        {
          echo "### ${JOB_NAME}"
          echo "- cargo and target cache: ${result}"
        } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
        du -sh "$HOME/.cargo/registry" "$HOME/.cargo/git" package/music-player/desktop-app/target 2>/dev/null || true

    # The real binary and the test executables, linked for the target. The tests are built here and run
    # in a later step so that the cache below is saved even when a test fails.
    - name: Build the tests (cargo nextest)
      id: build-tests
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: cargo nextest run --locked --target "$TARGET" --no-run

    - name: Build the binary
      id: build-binary
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: cargo build --locked --target "$TARGET"

    # Keep the entry lean: this package's own outputs change on every commit and are rebuilt anyway.
    - name: Prune this package's own artifacts from the cache directory
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' && steps.cargo-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.policy.outputs.save == 'true' }}
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        find target -type d -name incremental -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
        for pattern in 'music_player-*' 'libmusic_player-*' 'music-player-*' 'music-player.*' 'truepeak_core-*' 'libtruepeak_core-*' 'truepeak-core-*'; do
          find target -type f -path '*/deps/*' -name "$pattern" -delete
          find target -type d \( -path '*/.fingerprint/*' -o -path '*/build/*' \) -name "$pattern" -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
        done
        du -sh target "$HOME/.cargo/registry/index" "$HOME/.cargo/registry/cache" "$HOME/.cargo/git/db" 2>/dev/null || true

    - name: Save the cargo and target cache
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' && steps.cargo-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.policy.outputs.save == 'true' }}
      uses: actions/cache/save@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae
      with:
        path: |
          ~/.cargo/registry/index
          ~/.cargo/registry/cache
          ~/.cargo/git/db
          package/music-player/desktop-app/target
        key: ${{ steps.cargo-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

    - name: Save the MSYS2 package cache
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' && matrix.flavor == 'gnu' && steps.msys2-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' && steps.policy.outputs.save == 'true' }}
      uses: actions/cache/save@27d5ce7f107fe9357f9df03efb73ab90386fccae
      with:
        path: C:\msys64\var\cache\pacman\pkg
        key: ${{ steps.msys2-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}

    # rustc prints the exact linker command it runs. The first word is the linker program: link.exe for
    # MSVC, gcc (with -fuse-ld=bfd, so GNU ld) for GNU. lld-link or ld.lld here would be a defect.
    - name: Print the linker rustc ran
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        cargo rustc --locked --target "$TARGET" --bin music-player -- --print link-args > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/link-args.txt"
        head -c 400 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/link-args.txt"; echo
        first=$(head -n 1 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/link-args.txt" | awk '{ print tolower($1) }')
        case "$first" in
          *lld*) echo "::error::rustc linked with lld: $first"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        if [ "$FLAVOR" = 'gnu' ]; then
          grep --quiet -e '-fuse-ld=bfd' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/link-args.txt"
        fi
        # The #![windows_subsystem = "windows"] attribute reaches the linker as /SUBSYSTEM:windows (link.exe) or as
        # --subsystem windows (GNU ld, through the gcc driver as -Wl,--subsystem,windows).
        if [ "$FLAVOR" = 'gnu' ]; then
          grep --quiet -e '--subsystem,windows' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/link-args.txt"
        else
          grep --quiet --ignore-case -e '/SUBSYSTEM:windows' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/link-args.txt"
        fi
        echo "the linker was told to build a GUI-subsystem program"

    # The checks from here to the launch check run even when an earlier check failed, so one run reports every failure.
    - name: Inspect the PE file
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet pefile==2024.8.26
        exe="target/${TARGET}/debug/music-player.exe"
        ls -la "$exe"
        python - "$exe" <<'PYTHON'
        import sys
        import pefile
        pe = pefile.PE(sys.argv[1], fast_load=True)
        pe.parse_data_directories(directories=[
            pefile.DIRECTORY_ENTRY["IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT"],
            pefile.DIRECTORY_ENTRY["IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_DELAY_IMPORT"],
        ])
        header = pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER
        print(f"linker version in the PE header: {header.MajorLinkerVersion}.{header.MinorLinkerVersion}")
        # IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_WINDOWS_GUI is 2 and IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_WINDOWS_CUI (console) is 3; Windows opens a console
        # window for a double-clicked program with 3 and none for one with 2.
        subsystem = header.Subsystem
        subsystem_name = pefile.SUBSYSTEM_TYPE.get(subsystem, "unknown")
        print(f"Subsystem in the PE header: {subsystem} ({subsystem_name})")
        names = sorted({
            entry.dll.decode().lower()
            for attribute in ("DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IMPORT", "DIRECTORY_ENTRY_DELAY_IMPORT")
            for entry in getattr(pe, attribute, [])
        })
        print("imported DLLs:", ", ".join(names))
        crt = sorted(n for n in names if n == "msvcrt.dll" or n.startswith(("ucrtbase", "api-ms-win-crt", "vcruntime", "msvcp")))
        print("C runtime imports:", ", ".join(crt) or "none")
        gcc_runtime = [n for n in names if n.startswith(("libgcc_s", "libwinpthread", "libstdc++"))]
        problems = []
        if subsystem != 2:
            problems.append(f"the Subsystem field is {subsystem} ({subsystem_name}), expected 2 (IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_WINDOWS_GUI)")
        if gcc_runtime:
            problems.append(f"the program needs MinGW runtime DLLs next to it: {gcc_runtime}")
        if problems:
            raise SystemExit("; ".join(problems))
        PYTHON

    # The program is a GUI-subsystem executable, so a shell that does not capture its output does not wait for it. These
    # steps capture or redirect the output, which is what a script does with --version. The version text must still
    # reach a pipe (command substitution), a file (> and 2>) and the PowerShell pipeline.
    - name: Run the binary (--version and a bad argument, bash)
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        exe="target/${TARGET}/debug/music-player.exe"
        expected="music-player $(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml | head --lines=1 | tr --delete '\r')"
        out=$("$exe" --version)
        echo "pipe: $out"
        test "$out" = "$expected"
        "$exe" --version > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/version-stdout.txt"
        echo "file: $(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/version-stdout.txt")"
        test "$(tr --delete '\r' < "${RUNNER_TEMP}/version-stdout.txt")" = "$expected"
        # clap prints an argument error on stderr and exits with 2; stderr redirected to a file must hold the text.
        status=0
        "$exe" --no-such-option > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/bad-stdout.txt" 2> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/bad-stderr.txt" || status=$?
        echo "bad argument exit status: $status"
        cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/bad-stderr.txt"
        test "$status" = 2
        grep --quiet -e 'no-such-option' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/bad-stderr.txt"

    - name: Run the binary (--version, PowerShell)
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' }}
      shell: pwsh
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
        $exe = Join-Path (Get-Location) "target/$env:TARGET/debug/music-player.exe"
        $version = (Select-String -Path Cargo.toml -Pattern '^version = "(.*)"$' | Select-Object -First 1).Matches.Groups[1].Value
        $expected = "music-player $version"
        # The output is captured, so PowerShell waits for the program and the text reaches the step output.
        $captured = (& $exe --version | Out-String).Trim()
        Write-Output "captured in the pipeline: $captured"
        if ($captured -cne $expected) { throw "captured '$captured', expected '$expected'" }
        # The output goes to a file through PowerShell's redirection operator.
        $file = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'out.txt'
        & $exe --version > $file
        $fromFile = (Get-Content -Raw -Path $file).Trim()
        Write-Output "out.txt holds: $fromFile"
        if ($fromFile -cne $expected) { throw "out.txt holds '$fromFile', expected '$expected'" }
        # The same through the 2>&1 merge that scripts use to log both streams.
        $merged = (& $exe --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
        Write-Output "merged streams: $merged"
        if ($merged -cne $expected) { throw "merged '$merged', expected '$expected'" }
        # Not captured: PowerShell does not wait for a GUI program, but the program writes to the handle it inherited, so
        # the text still lands in this step's log. The sleep keeps this step open until the program has written.
        Write-Output 'uncaptured run follows; the next line is printed by the program itself'
        & $exe --version
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 5

    # The program must stay up when started on a folder, with no audio device on the runner. A start that
    # exits within the wait fails the job.
    - name: Launch the program and check it stays up
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      env:
        RUST_LOG: info
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        "target/${TARGET}/debug/music-player.exe" fixture > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/launch.log" 2>&1 &
        pid=$!
        sleep 15
        if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "still running after 15 seconds"
          kill "$pid" || true
        else
          echo "::error::the program exited within 15 seconds"
          cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/launch.log"
          exit 1
        fi
        head -n 40 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/launch.log"

    - name: Run the tests (cargo nextest)
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-tests.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      run: cargo nextest run --locked --target "$TARGET" --no-fail-fast
    - name: Run independent original PowerShell merged-stream probe
      id: powershell-merged-stream
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' }}
      shell: pwsh
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      env:
        SOURCE_HEAD: 3434eaa455d569c18b52cf15100f77f9db251d21
        COHORT_ID: ${{ inputs.cohort_id }}
        COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.manifest_sha256 }}
        COHORT_REQUESTED_AT: ${{ inputs.requested_at }}
      run: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
        $exe = Join-Path (Get-Location) "target/$env:TARGET/debug/music-player.exe"
        $version = (Select-String -Path Cargo.toml -Pattern '^version = "(.*)"$' | Select-Object -First 1).Matches.Groups[1].Value
        $expected = "music-player $version"
        $probeStatus = 'failed'
        $merged = ''
        try {
          # The same through the 2>&1 merge that scripts use to log both streams.
          $merged = (& $exe --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()
          Write-Output "merged streams: $merged"
          if ($merged -cne $expected) { throw "merged '$merged', expected '$expected'" }
          $probeStatus = 'passed'
        }
        finally {
          $evidenceDirectory = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'depot-provenance'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $evidenceDirectory -Force | Out-Null
          $record = @{
            schemaVersion = 1
            event = 'independent-consumer-result'
            probe = 'powershell-merged-stream'
            status = $probeStatus
            expectedVersion = $expected
            actualCaptured = $merged
            requiresStepLogVersionCheck = $false
            sourceRevision = $env:SOURCE_HEAD
            harnessRevision = $env:GITHUB_SHA
            cohortId = $env:COHORT_ID
            manifestSha256 = $env:COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256
            requestedAt = $env:COHORT_REQUESTED_AT
            originalProbeSha256 = '70254e9a8a0d74be169da3e90243fb9bb60046be08551fd5d1153a822a8c5c90'
            beforeProvenance = 'before.json'
            afterProvenance = 'after.json'
            powershellVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
          }
          $recordPath = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'powershell-merged-stream.json'
          $record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $recordPath -Encoding utf8
        }
    - name: Run independent original PowerShell uncaptured-console probe
      id: powershell-uncaptured-console
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build-binary.outcome == 'success' }}
      shell: pwsh
      working-directory: package/music-player/desktop-app
      env:
        SOURCE_HEAD: 3434eaa455d569c18b52cf15100f77f9db251d21
        COHORT_ID: ${{ inputs.cohort_id }}
        COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.manifest_sha256 }}
        COHORT_REQUESTED_AT: ${{ inputs.requested_at }}
      run: |
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
        $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $true
        $exe = Join-Path (Get-Location) "target/$env:TARGET/debug/music-player.exe"
        $version = (Select-String -Path Cargo.toml -Pattern '^version = "(.*)"$' | Select-Object -First 1).Matches.Groups[1].Value
        $expected = "music-player $version"
        $probeStatus = 'failed'
        try {
          # Not captured: PowerShell does not wait for a GUI program, but the program writes to the handle it inherited, so
          # the text still lands in this step's log. The sleep keeps this step open until the program has written.
          Write-Output 'uncaptured run follows; the next line is printed by the program itself'
          & $exe --version
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
          $probeStatus = 'completed'
        }
        finally {
          $evidenceDirectory = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'depot-provenance'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $evidenceDirectory -Force | Out-Null
          $record = @{
            schemaVersion = 1
            event = 'independent-consumer-result'
            probe = 'powershell-uncaptured-console'
            status = $probeStatus
            expectedVersion = $expected
            actualCaptured = $null
            requiresStepLogVersionCheck = $true
            sourceRevision = $env:SOURCE_HEAD
            harnessRevision = $env:GITHUB_SHA
            cohortId = $env:COHORT_ID
            manifestSha256 = $env:COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256
            requestedAt = $env:COHORT_REQUESTED_AT
            originalProbeSha256 = '563a0bb5973b5781378dd00666cc9d59d245449fd8ec4189ba5d690feb09c69d'
            beforeProvenance = 'before.json'
            afterProvenance = 'after.json'
            powershellVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
          }
          $recordPath = Join-Path $evidenceDirectory 'powershell-uncaptured-console.json'
          $record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $recordPath -Encoding utf8
        }
    - name: Record frozen source provenance after consumers
      if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.provenance-before.outcome == 'success' }}
      working-directory: trial-provenance-harness
      env:
        MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
        MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS: ${{ github.workspace }}
        MISE_NODE_VERSION: '26.11.1'
        SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
        SOURCE_HEAD: 3434eaa455d569c18b52cf15100f77f9db251d21
        PROVENANCE_PHASE: after
        PROVENANCE_CASE: windows
        PROVENANCE_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/depot-provenance
        COHORT_ID: ${{ inputs.cohort_id }}
        COHORT_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.manifest_sha256 }}
        COHORT_REQUESTED_AT: ${{ inputs.requested_at }}
      run: mise run //package/dev-script/task-util:trial:depot:coherent:provenance
    - name: Preserve frozen source provenance
      if: ${{ always() }}
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: depot-windows-provenance-${{ matrix.name }}
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/depot-provenance
        if-no-files-found: error
